description: Codify empirically-learned test-quality rules into the reviewer Layer B rubric (nuanced anti-mock, adversarial-cases, per-test discipline) plus a durable convention and the waitForCondition helper it points to.

userStories.title: Create waitForCondition poll-until-true test helper
userStories.description: As a test author writing real-I/O integration tests, I need a waitForCondition(predicate, timeout) helper so that async waits in the real-tmux/git tier use a bounded poll instead of a fixed setTimeout/Bun.sleepSync, which is the anti-flake target the new per-test rubric item will point at.
acceptanceCriteria: test/helpers/wait-for-condition.ts exports a waitForCondition helper that repeatedly evaluates a predicate until it returns true (or truthy), then resolves. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'export' test/helpers/wait-for-condition.ts && grep -q 'waitForCondition' test/helpers/wait-for-condition.ts]
The helper rejects (throws) when the predicate stays false past a configurable timeout, rather than hanging or resolving. [oracle: bun test]
A unit test proves both paths: it resolves once the condition becomes true, and it rejects/throws on timeout. [oracle: bun test]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Full quality spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: New files: test/helpers/wait-for-condition.ts (mirrors kebab-case of existing test/helpers/flush-ink.ts, mock-terminal-size.ts) + its unit test (e.g. test/wait-for-condition.test.ts, picked up by bun test via test/**). Keep the helper zero-dependency (string/promise-in, promise-out; no git/tmux/fs). This is intended for the real-I/O integration tier (test/integration/*-real-*) where a clock cannot be injected into a real subprocess; do NOT refactor existing legitimate fake-clock injections (test/dashboard.test.ts, test/retry/launcher.test.ts) to use it. GOTCHA (patterns.md:30): the unit test's own poll must use a tiny pollIntervalMs + short timeoutMs so it does not burn Bun's 5s per-test timeout; a mutable flag flipped after N polls proves the resolve path deterministically without real sleeping. Guard noUncheckedIndexedAccess. This story is scoped to the helper only; cleanup of existing Bun.sleepSync waits and any deterministic setTimeout check:all gate are explicitly split to the CAM-62 follow-up.

userStories.title: Add test-quality rubric guidance to the cam reviewer agent (.claude copy)
userStories.description: As the reviewer agent (Layer B), I need codified test-quality rubric guidance anchored on binary criterion #2 so that I FAIL tautological mock-call assertions, demand adversarial cases, and enforce per-test discipline instead of relying on undocumented judgment.
acceptanceCriteria: .claude/agents/subagent-reviewer.md gains test-quality guidance anchored on / expanding binary criterion #2 (tests-with-meaningful-assert), covering three items: (a) a 3-clause anti-mock rule, (b) an adversarial-cases mandate, (c) a per-test discipline checklist. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

The anti-mock rule bans tautological 'the mock was called' assertions using the warren aphorism verbatim, mandates a real-I/O test at each wire boundary (git/tmux/gh/filesystem), and explicitly ALLOWS behavioral DI-fakes that reproduce a real dependency's observable output. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'documentation, not verification' .claude/agents/subagent-reviewer.md]

The adversarial-cases mandate requires tests to cover malformed input, boundary values, and regression-of-a-past-bug (not happy-path only). [oracle: file-assert grep -qi 'adversarial' .claude/agents/subagent-reviewer.md && grep -qi 'boundary' .claude/agents/subagent-reviewer.md]

The per-test discipline item requires behavior-named tests, one concept per test, a success/error/edge triad, and async waits via a waitForCondition helper NOT a fixed setTimeout/Bun.sleepSync. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'waitForCondition' .claude/agents/subagent-reviewer.md]
The change does NOT alter the count of the binary verdict criteria: the prompt still states '8 fixed criteria'. [oracle: file-assert grep -q '8 fixed criteria' .claude/agents/subagent-reviewer.md]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Full quality spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Edit only .claude/agents/subagent-reviewer.md (the cam-specialized runtime copy; it is NOT embedded, so no embed-vendor here). Anchor the guidance on criterion #2 in the 8-criteria block (~line 111-114) and/or the 'Green tests do not prove correctness' section (~line 121-124). GOTCHA (issue gotchas): a verbatim 'FAIL any new fake/mock/spy' rule is INCOHERENT for cam-cli (119/252 test files use blessed behavioral DI-fakes, 0 use module-mocking); the rule bans only tautological mock-call assertions and mandates real-I/O at boundaries. Do NOT add a 9th criterion or change the binary verdict count (issue scope). GOTCHA (orch-no-hardkill lesson): if the added prose pushes the file over its scripts/file-size-budget.json entry, raise that _ref budget in the SAME commit (check:all enforces it). The existing test/integration/*-real-* tier already institutionalizes the real-I/O half; you are codifying it, not building a new tier.
